_comment: Process names (without .exe) that should take the GPU away from Ollama. Matching is case-insensitive. Trailing '*' works as a prefix wildcard, e.g. 'ShooterGame*'. Add to this list freely; Game-Watch.ps1 re-reads it every poll, so no restart is needed.

launchers._comment: Launchers alone do NOT pause the GPU - Steam idling in the tray should not cost you the fleet. Listed here only for the -Candidates helper output.
